objective: Discover and compare external open-source trace/provenance/re-entry mechanisms that can strengthen F2-WP-508 GWT re-entry/provenance falsification while preserving exact generation/frame identity and without creating a second truth/effect authority.

architecture_staleness_review.reason: The later pyvene delta treats WP508 as a later model-internal lesion/rescue and provenance acceptance surface. This E1 objective remains external re-entry/provenance lineage research and does not assume hidden-state access, so the scopes are complementary rather than contradictory.

observed_mechanisms: immutable SpanContext carrying TraceId and SpanId for propagation
explicit parent relationship plus zero-or-more Links to other SpanContexts
links may cross traces and may carry attributes
context propagation is separate from application truth semantics
candidates.recommended_use: Distill a derived witness envelope for re-entry correlation and asynchronous predecessor links. Keep F2 causal/frame/generation identities authoritative; OpenTelemetry IDs are never canonical F2 truth or proof of semantic uptake.
candidates.counterhypothesis: Trace/span metadata may merely duplicate existing F2 causal identities and can create false confidence if observability correlation is mistaken for provenance authority.
candidates.falsifier_direction: A later F2 provenance test must reject wrong generation, wrong SituationFrame digest, wrong recipient, orphan link, and replayed-delivery cases even when a syntactically valid trace/span relation exists.

observed_mechanisms: explicit parent job/run plus optional root job/run lineage
forwarded parent/root facets are declared convenience copies and the parent/root own event remains the full-information authority
candidates.recommended_use: Distill the parent/root provenance rule: forwarded lineage is a projection/witness and never overrides the canonical source event. Do not import the data-lineage runtime as a second F2 state substrate.
candidates.counterhypothesis: The parent/root model is data-pipeline-specific and may add schema weight without improving F2 rejection of stale or forged re-entry lineage.
candidates.falsifier_direction: Compare a minimal parent/root projection against current F2 provenance tests; it must uniquely expose at least one stale/forged lineage case or be rejected as redundant.

candidates.recommended_use: Retain durable re-entry/recovery as a comparison model only. Do not adopt Temporal server/event-history persistence as F2 runtime authority because that risks introducing a second execution/state substrate.
candidates.counterhypothesis: The durable execution platform is too heavy and semantically broader than WP508; a thin F2-native provenance contract can capture the needed restart/re-entry invariants more safely.
candidates.falsifier_direction: Only escalate if a source-mapped Temporal invariant uniquely closes a concrete WP508 provenance gap that the thinner OpenTelemetry/OpenLineage distillation cannot close.

fields_to_map_in_e2: canonical F2 causal event identity reference
generated_minimal_f2_hypothesis.authority_fence: External trace/lineage identifiers can corroborate transport/provenance shape but can never repair or override a failed canonical F2 frame/generation/recipient binding and can never mint GWT semantic uptake, causal influence, effect success, or world truth.

why_not_import_whole_tools: F2 already has canonical UnifiedDB and typed causal identity authority
WP508 needs fail-closed provenance discrimination, not another workflow/data-lineage truth store
OpenTelemetry and OpenLineage offer small transferable identity/lineage patterns without requiring their full backends
Temporal is intentionally retained as a heavyweight negative-control architecture

next_discriminator.summary: Map the minimal OpenTelemetry SpanContext/Link and OpenLineage parent/root-authority concepts onto exact current F2 WP506/WP507/WP508 identities, then specify fail-closed stale-generation, wrong-frame-digest, cross-recipient, orphan-link and replay cases before any implementation or runtime test.
